finding: Old global pointer finite-range law plus inverse and unrestricted addr offsets are logically inconsistent.
status: Confirmed mathematical conflict; source-to-premises mapping independently peer-reviewed. Not a claim that every historical model/version contains these premises.
mathematical_theorem: range_inverse_conflict: for every finite m, a bounded encode on all base=0 integer offsets cannot have a left inverse.
archived_13_note: Archived profiles are Typed/Typed+float, not these new Bytes profiles; no automatic conclusion of same issue. Their other declared TCB and known rsum model hypotheses remain separately tracked.
remediation: Separate new model removes only global pointers_int_range injection; old C/spec/proof retained, fresh full and independent runs required. Removing one conflict does not establish consistency of all remaining model axioms.
